Boucherville delivery

Pallets, containers and urgent shipments for businesses in the industrial park, moves for residents: Boucherville, one tunnel away from Montreal.

Groupe Gama in Boucherville

Boucherville is home to one of the largest industrial parks on the South Shore: distributors, manufacturers and distribution centres receive and ship pallets there every day. Groupe Gama works mostly for businesses there — pallet transport, urgent deliveries of parts and goods, handling crews to empty containers — while also serving residents for their weekend moves.

What we do for you

  • Pallet transport to and from the Boucherville industrial park
  • Crews of 2 to 10 handlers to unload 20- and 40-foot containers
  • Urgent shipments to Montreal’s east end via the Louis-Hippolyte-La Fontaine Tunnel
  • Next-day routes to customers across the South Shore and Montreal
  • Residential moves on weekends

Access and delivery times

Highway 25 and the Louis-Hippolyte-La Fontaine Tunnel connect Boucherville directly to Montreal’s east end, and Highways 20 and 30 to the rest of the South Shore. That is a real advantage for businesses delivering to Anjou, Montréal-Est or the port: the crossing is short and predictable outside rush hour.

FAQ

FAQ — Boucherville

Can you move pallets from the Boucherville industrial park?

Yes, standard and oversized pallets, with or without a dock at destination (liftgate and pallet jack). Same-day or next-day AM or PM delivery.

How long does it take to unload a 40-foot container?

Floor-loaded, usually 2 to 4 hours with 3 or 4 people; faster if palletized. We size the crew to your unloading window.

Do you deliver from Boucherville to Montreal’s east end the same day?

Yes, via the Louis-Hippolyte-La Fontaine Tunnel, within a few hours depending on traffic.

Do you do moves in Boucherville?

Yes, on weekends, with an equipped truck, fuel, mileage and insurance included.
